calculator_results.title: History persists after activity restart and can restore an expression
calculator_results.expected: History shows 1+1 = 2 and restores the expression
calculator_results.actual: history=History · 7 | Clear | Close history | = 0.3 | 200+10% | 27th Oct, 09:15 | = 220 | √(9) | = 3 | sin(30) | = 0.5 | 1+1 | 27th Oct, 09:16 | = 2; restored=CALCULATOR | 1+1 | = 2
calculator_results.comment: The history entry survived process restart and restored its expression.

calculator_results.title: Grouped history card restores and re-evaluates without Error
calculator_results.expected: History card re-evaluates to 123457 without Error
calculator_results.comment: The grouped expression was restored and evaluated successfully; display commas did not contaminate the calculation.

calculator_results.title: Chained calculations retain unrounded precision
calculator_results.comment: After 1 ÷ 3 =, the UI result was ['CALCULATOR', '0.3333333333']; multiplying by 3 did not return 1. This is consistent with the screen feeding its rounded display string back into the next expression.

calculator_results.title: Scientific-notation result can be used in the next expression
calculator_results.comment: Initial 10^15 display was ['CALCULATOR', '1e+15']; adding +1 left an unchanged exponent result or produced Error. This is consistent with exponent-formatted display text not being accepted as a numeric literal by the expression validator/parser.

calculator_results.title: Live comparison with official Google Calculator
calculator_results.comment: The official Google Calculator package was not present in the emulator image. No third-party APK mirror was used. Functional assertions therefore use the documented arithmetic expectations; this is not a live side-by-side Google comparison.

user_results.title: Apply Light and Dark calculator themes
user_results.expected: Light and Dark choices visibly change the calculator screen
user_results.actual: stable-screen pixel change=98.3%; Light SHA-256=a226db3a9948746f70062858eae2aa8b3fe48c1c90d0d5825f07ac102bc03ca3; Dark SHA-256=d4fabd9acbbe3f30f5b604c519e7f917b299066b080f4fef74ddd4bc6f30463f; expression=['CALCULATOR', '0']
user_results.comment: Both Light and Dark choices produced visibly different calculator screens. The displayed expression reset during the settings/home route, so expression persistence is not claimed. Exact palette/caret pixels are not asserted.

user_results.title: Scan visible calculator labels for ad indicators
user_results.expected: No visible ad labels on the calculator screen
user_results.actual: Scanned 31 visible labels; no ad indicator
user_results.comment: No ad-like text appeared on the sampled calculator screen; this does not certify the app's network or SDK behavior.

limits: Direct APK evidence comes from Android 14/API 34 emulator UI actions, screenshots and hierarchy dumps.
Only calculator screens and calculator-specific settings are exercised; other MySpace apps are out of scope.
The calculator ad check scans sampled visible text; it is not a network or third-party SDK audit.
Source-CI runs are reported separately from direct APK results.
